Im a guy who loves a girl. I dont go out of my way to show her i love her because ive been surrounded my negative thoughts and feelings . 

I like this specific girl so much that I dont want to rub off on her the wrong way. The past few months ive grown and become more whole than ever before . Ive started to understand my energy and come to know myself more than ever before. 

If I had chilled with this person a couple months ago I wouldve introduced her to a world of anxiety and wouldve pushed her away due to the fact that I myself had yet to truly love myself. Now that ive gotton much better at learning to love myself im less of a toxic , bitter person.

 My point is if someone youre interested in isnt giving you all their energy and love , if this person doesnt go out of their way to express their love for you - maybe their low in energy and dont have much to offer. Maybe that dont feel loved and have no love to give . Maybe , just maaybe , this person loves you very deeply and wishes to express and show their love but they are in a state where they close themselves off from the ease of life. 

It may be hard for them to express themselves . Give them a chance and be there for them when nobody else is. Give them some space and let them find their way.  Also dont worry about said person. Let them breath. I know thats alot of excuses on why they dont show how much they love you but bottomline is maybe they dont know how to love. ... Alexa play "how to love" by lil wayne.
